changes.summary: compileHarness compares the input and output validators an operation descriptor lists, and the mapping an entry contract lists, by installed name, so a catalog whose alias table renames only an operation's validators or only an entry's mapping compiles; the alias such a listed name relies on is recorded in provenance.aliases. installedReadAdapters requires each read validator the harness pins, found through its recorded aliases, to equal the first-party validator the read lists.
